changelog:
v1.0.72: Fixed Menu Overlap Isolation & Alternating C/E/Q Anti-AFK
- Fixed Menu Overlap: Re-isolated tabs with grid_remove to completely eliminate visual bugs and restore all panels
- Strict Key Alternation: Anti-AFK now strictly alternates between C, E, and Q with 0% chance of repeating the same key
- Live Overlay & UI Sync: HUD and Pill clearly show the upcoming and executing key in real-time
